extracted.name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
extracted.description: This cucumber tomato salad tosses sliced cucumbers, fresh tomatoes, and onion in a sweet and tangy vinaigrette dressing for an easy summer side.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or to taste
1 onion, sliced and separated into rings
instruction_lines: Whisk water, vinegar, oil, sugar, salt, and black pepper together in a large bowl until smooth.
Add cucumbers, tomatoes, and onion; stir to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate for at least 2 hours for best flavor results.
